2026 UPDATE · QUARTER ONE

A RECORD
START.

The first quarter of 2026 was one of the busiest and most exciting starts to a year in Proteus history. Nearly 60 coaches delivered programmes across Christchurch as we strengthened relationships with schools, clubs and community organisations and expanded the sports we support.

ACROSS TERM ONE, WE

A RECORD
QUARTER.

  • Coaching delivered across dozens of schools and clubs
  • Nearly 60 coaches delivering programmes
  • Expansion into multiple new sports
  • Stronger operations and leadership
  • Hundreds of athletes supported every week
  • Growing community partnerships

WHAT’S BEEN HAPPENING

EVERY CORNER
OF THE GAME.

Schools, clubs, holidays,
individuals and early years.

SCHOOLS

Delivering across schools

From early years to senior performance teams: secondary school football, prep and primary development sessions, hockey, futsal and basketball coaching, and structured curriculum delivery.

CLUBS

Club partnerships

Proteus coaches took on major roles in club academy and performance programmes, including technical coaching, performance analysis, strength and conditioning and senior team support.

HOLIDAYS

Holiday programmes keep growing

One of our fastest-growing services. Structured programmes ran across multiple locations, and demand continues to increase.

INDIVIDUAL

Individual athlete development

A growing group of athletes trained in personalised sessions designed around their own development goals.

EARLY YEARS

Building strong foundations

Our early childhood programmes expanded across more early learning centres, developing movement skills, coordination and confidence.

EXPANDING INTO NEW SPORTS

FOOTBALL FIRST.
AND MORE.

Football remains the heart of Proteus. Growing demand from schools and clubs has taken us into five more codes, with recruitment pathways led by Isaac Rockell.

  • Football Primary focus
  • Futsal
  • Basketball
  • Hockey
  • Touch Rugby
  • Cricket
